title: VERTICES PARTNERS, Lexapar, IC RegFin Legal and Luthra act on PlayBlue fundraise
description: Play Blue Sports Private Limited has raised $2.7 million from a seed fundraise co-led by Centre Court Capital and MIXI Global, with participation from WEH Ventures.VERTICES PARTNERS advised PlayBlue on this fundraise.The transaction was led by Vishal Mehta (Partner), along with a team that included, Associates Darshan Rajesh Chheda and Cashmira Poonacha.Founder and Managing Partner Vinayak Burman provided strategic inputs.Vishal Mehta, Vinayak BurmanLexapar advised lead investor Center Cour
